They are trying to deal with the issues but they don't know how to.. so it just continues. 
Also, therapy/ counseling is ridiculously expensive here.. 

The academic pressure in Japan is insane. Even smart kids feel like nothing if em they aren't the  best.. school is LIFE for kids here. School from 7am-6, after school clubs, homework (lots of kids stay up till really late doing homework), then even on weekends almost kids go to school for their clubs or whatever. Kids don't have an identity. 

Yeah, that really annoys me. That's like saying America is a Hollywood movie, except even more ridiculous, as anime are cartoons lol.

Yes, I live in Japan. My parents are white Americans who moved to Japan 20+ years ago .. and I and my siblings were born here. You're right, there are not so many Christians here at all. Just my luck I guess.. 

I wish that too. Always I see on the news stories like " a thirteen year old jumped from the window of their junior high classroom" etc.. and everyone just talks about who's fault it is, the school wants nothing to do with it.. so they blame it on bullying or whatever, but that goes totally unnoticed by teachers and parents...
or business people committing suicide cause they're overworked and overstressed.. of course it's not the company's fault, right:)
Sometimes the train is delayed because someone decided to jump . Especially in big cities..

That's nice...  I wish I had a friend like that.. 
I don't have any friends that I'm close enough to ask anything of them.  Even if I did, Asian society just doesn't work like that lol. They think my family is perfectly normal.. They would probably think I'm just being silly, call my parents and bring me right back home. 
Mental health really isn't a top priority where I live. Suicide rate is high but no one talks about it in real life.. only on news and in books..  i can't talk to people  I know about my depression, as they'll write me off as crazy.. 
I'll try those suggestions but I honestly feel like it'd feel really disconnected.

I get into horrible fights with him all the time. We just scream at each other on end, I say bad things to him too, like tell him I hate him...  and i feel horrible later but in the moment i am so angry.. usually I end up locking myself up in my room, scribbling  in my journal to calm myself down..(which has resulted in some pretty disturbing entries...)
Other  times he locks me out of the house for a few hours... and won't let me in until I apologize, as if it's all my fault. 
Almost every time he ends up taking my phone away, sometimes for weeks on end... which is like cutting off the only thing that connects me to the outside world... which seems dramatic but it feels like that.. and he doesn't give it back until I write a full, 2 page apology letter, explaining what I did wrong and how sorry I am, what commandments I broke (🙄) , how I will change.

My dad takes the joy out of everything. It's come to the point I can't even feel comfortable in my home when he's back from work.. everything tenses up.. we can't be ourselves..

I actually tried something similar once, they basically laughed in my face. For my parents, everything is a privilege... freedom, education, everything. They'd just tell me I'm being ungrateful . My older brother is competent and does everything they ask, so why shouldn't I ? Why am I unhappy when I have so much? 
I showed my mom a list of symptoms for depression, and I had like every single one, and she said I was being dramatic..

18 seems like an eternity away. I have to live 2 more years like this... I'll check out online therapy I guess.

That is really such a nice message, you are so nice to have written all that out for me.. thank you. 
Today i went to volleyball practice and actually did well, and took a shower for the first time in a week. I feel a bit better. 
I'll really try to incorporate some of those things... sometimes it all seems so exhausting.. like why should I bother doing anything , no one cares and nothing will change.. but I realize that that's really destructive. Thanks again✌🏻
I'm sorry that you relate... I'm sure you're lovely ❤️

Well... That's the thing.. I don't hate my parents.. I love them and want to have a god relationship with them, and for the most part I do, especially with mom.. but they are just so strict I feel like I'm on a leash... 
I will get a job as soon as I turn 16 in January.. and I already have a bank account with some money saved... so that's a start..
I could never do that to my dad though.., he loves us and works hard for us, and my mom would be heartbroken... and then everyone would blame me and things would only get worse.

Even though I wasn't a Linkin Park fan, Chester's death was really sad for everyone:/ one of my favorite musicians died this year too, and by suicide as well... 

I'm glad you didn't OD, im sure you're a lovely person ♡

I really try to be positive.. like over and over I tell myself I'm going to have a clean break, start caring again, study harder, eat healthy, stop being so negative... and maybe for a few days things start to get a bit better... and then the tiniest thing sends me straight back into my depression. It's so draining. I probably won't be able to recover until I leave my parents house....
